question: How is my money transferred?
answer: You transfer your investment from your own bank account to the fund's account with SBM Bank (Mauritius). From there, funds are transferred to the fund's brokerage account with Interactive Brokers (IBKR), held at Citibank, New York in IBKR's name. Redemption proceeds follow the same route in reverse. Our team will provide you the bank details for the wire transfer.
